question_text: How long will Karoline Leavitt speak for at next Press Briefing?
resolution_criteria:
If Karoline Leavitt speaks for 65 or above minutes at the next Press Briefing before Jan 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
Speaking will be measured from first word audibly said by Karoline Leavitt to the last word audibly said by Karoline Leavitt. Pauses in speech will be included in the speech time if they are between those two points. *If additional speaker(s) participate in the Press Briefing and become the primary speaker, the length of Karoline Leavitt's Press Briefing speech will include the other speaker(s) if Karoline Leavitt regains the primary speaker position. *
